props.title: Start Collaboration
props.seoTitle: Start a Thoughtful Research Collaboration | Aarti Sri Ravikumar
props.description: A calm, privacy-conscious path for mentorship, community research, technical contribution, and speaking inquiries.
props.seoDescription: Start a thoughtful collaboration with Aarti Sri Ravikumar. Choose mentorship, community research, technical open-source, or speaking and submit a focused inquiry.
props.keywords: student research collaboration, mentorship, community research, open source collaboration

props.heading: Build something useful, with care.
props.description: Aarti welcomes thoughtful academic, community, and technical conversations. Start with the kind of collaboration you have in mind; the next questions stay focused.
props.agreement: I understand this starts an inquiry, not a commitment, and I will not include confidential or sensitive personal information.

paths.title: Mentor or educator
paths.description: Share perspective, feedback, learning opportunities, or research guidance.
paths.prompt: What perspective, question, or learning opportunity would you like to discuss?

paths.title: Research or community partner
paths.description: Explore a local question, evidence need, or practical pilot.
paths.prompt: What community question, audience, or outcome are you exploring?

paths.title: Technical or open-source collaborator
paths.description: Discuss code, design, documentation, testing, or an existing project.
paths.prompt: Which project or technical area is relevant, and what contribution or partnership do you have in mind?

paths.title: Speaking, press, or another idea
paths.description: For events, interviews, introductions, or a proposal that does not fit above.
paths.prompt: What is the purpose of your note, and why might it be a good fit?
